name: shadcn-calendar-heatmap
summary: React calendar heatmap component built on react-day-picker for contribution graphs and activity tracking.
description: A copy-paste React component that turns react-day-picker into a calendar heatmap, showing dates at varying color intensities for contribution graphs, activity tracking or temperature maps. Dates map to variants either as explicit per-variant arrays or as weighted numbers the component auto-categorizes, with multi-month display and Tailwind CSS styling.
contains: copy-paste React component built on react-day-picker
intensity variants with custom Tailwind classes
weightedDates auto-categorization or explicit datesPerVariant arrays
examples: contribution graph, temperature heatmap, rainbow colors
helpers: variantClassnames, showOutsideDays, DayPicker props passthrough
